appliedUpdates.description: Added Flow Validator Guidance: M2 Components section documenting isolation rules, concurrency limits, tools used, and off-limits paths for M2 component validators

validatorGroups.summary: Bounded[Req,Upd] runtime has 15 test cases covering all 7 required behaviors. No regressions: existing runtime tests are new additions (not modifications). All 5 entity types exist with 18 EntryKind constants and tested legacy mapper.

EntityList (22+ tests), DetailPane (24 tests), Tabs (31 tests), Drawer (25 tests) all pass with -race. Focus indicators use color (not font-weight). Navigation, wrap-around, focus traps, and empty states all verified. Multiple tuistory snapshots per widget.

StreamViewer (17 tests) covers follow-tail, scroll-anchor, burst-of-1000. Small primitives (23 tests) cover 4 distinct StatusBadge variants (green/amber/red/purple). Unicode tests (29 subtests) cover CJK, combining marks, ZWJ emoji, and RTL across all 4 specified widgets.

Zero raw color literals in widget code (70+ theme.Colors.* references). README has all 5 sections. Authoring walkthroughs present for FooBadge and Rooms with all cited commands/paths verified. Zero time.Now/rand/os.Getenv in production widget code.
